entries.text: 新增工单 SQL 执行所需的三张跟踪表
entries.textEn: Added the three tracking tables needed for ticket SQL execution

entries.text: 修复处理索引数量前未先保存索引的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed indexes not being saved before their count was used

entries.text: 新增无索引阶段的索引推荐保存逻辑
entries.textEn: Added saving of index recommendations for the no-index stage

entries.text: 修复校验逻辑的空指针问题
entries.textEn: Fixed a null-pointer problem in the validation logic

entries.text: 性能验证前处理变量与不支持的 SQL 类型
entries.textEn: Variables and unsupported SQL types are handled before performance validation

entries.text: 提取并统一解析异常的持久化逻辑
完善非事务执行模式的会话处理
entries.textEn: Completed session handling for non-transactional execution

entries.text: 提取错误消息常量，并拦截离线工作空间的执行
entries.textEn: Extracted error-message constants and blocked execution in offline workspaces

entries.text: 硬编码错误信息改为国际化常量键
entries.textEn: Hardcoded error messages became i18n constant keys

entries.text: 工单执行会话支持超时自动回滚与合法性校验
entries.textEn: Ticket execution sessions support timeout rollback and validity checks

entries.text: 新增按工单 ID 获取执行会话历史列表的接口
entries.textEn: Added an endpoint listing execution-session history by ticket ID

entries.text: 新增执行会话终止功能
entries.textEn: Added termination of an execution session

entries.text: 新增执行会话的连接丢失检测与处理
entries.textEn: Added detection and handling of lost execution-session connections

entries.text: 执行会话支持跳过当前 SQL 与超时自动回滚
entries.textEn: Execution sessions can skip the current SQL and roll back on timeout

entries.text: 执行会话支持批量执行全部 SQL 与参数化执行
entries.textEn: Execution sessions support running all SQL in one batch and parameterised execution

entries.text: 工单 M2 级 SQL 执行会话支持执行、提交与回滚
entries.textEn: M2-level ticket SQL execution sessions support execute, commit and rollback

entries.text: 实现工单 SQL 执行会话预览（M1）
entries.textEn: Implemented ticket SQL execution session preview (M1)

entries.text: 新增多数据库方言执行支持框架
